children: Natural gas futures have fallen below the $3 per million British thermal units threshold. Futures are looking for support, says EBW Analytics in a note. But it being the end of the month, natural gas futures may soon stop their slide, EBW says. "Day-to-day production readings remain volatile and imprecise," says the firm. "Phantom first-of-month declines are probable tomorrow." But how long natural gas prices continues to fall depends on how long the weather stays warmer than normal in the eastern U.S. Natural gas futures are down 0.7% to $2.99 per mmBtu. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
